mapper.sql: application_id AS applicationId, application_code AS applicationCode, application_name AS applicationName, default_locale AS defaultLocale, required_locales AS requiredLocalesJson, coverage_threshold_percent AS coverageThresholdPercent, current_release_id AS currentReleaseId, key_set_revision AS keySetRevision, content_revision AS contentRevision, status, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_i18n_application (application_id, application_code, application_name, default_locale, required_locales, coverage_threshold_percent, current_release_id, key_set_revision, content_revision, status, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.applicationId}, #{row.applicationCode}, #{row.applicationName}, #{row.defaultLocale}, #{row.requiredLocalesJson}, #{row.coverageThresholdPercent}, #{row.currentReleaseId}, #{row.keySetRevision}, #{row.contentRevision}, #{row.status}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_i18n_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_i18n_application ORDER BY application_code
SELECT application_code FROM t_i18n_application WHERE default_locale = #{localeCode} OR JSON_CONTAINS(required_locales, JSON_QUOTE(#{localeCode})) ORDER BY application_code
